## Checklist

- [ ] The change does one thing.
- [ ] `pnpm test` and `pnpm typecheck` pass locally.
- [ ] New or changed engine behaviour has a test (with a published textbook example where one exists).
- [ ] UI works with the keyboard alone, in light and dark themes, and at 360px wide.
- [ ] Animations respect `prefers-reduced-motion`.
- [ ] No hard-coded colours in components (theme tokens only).
- [ ] Learn content is in my own words, with sources linked rather than copied.
